Data completeness: full month, ~1-mile-radius catchment around Camden's centre — 2981 recorded incidents for 2026-06. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for that catchment, not a truncated sample — but it's a circle around the borough centre, not the exact administrative boundary, so incidents right at the edges of Camden may be over- or under-counted. Day score: 1.2395 weighted incidents/1,000 people (105% of the 5-borough average). Night score: 8.1533 weighted incidents/1,000 people (124% of the 5-borough average). Both are normalised by an estimated workday/footfall population of 407,111 (2021 resident population of 210,200, scaled by the 2011 Census resident-vs-workday ratio for Camden — see methodology) rather than plain resident population, so central boroughs with heavy commuter/visitor footfall aren't overstated as riskier just for having fewer official residents. Rated against the average of the 5 boroughs currently on the automated pipeline, not yet a full London average.
